lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a staggered grid. Three distinct vertical columns are visible on the mid-flank, with the leftmost primary column containing four high-intensity maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs, forming a discernible grid of high-contrast anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A school of approximately twenty small fish is visible in the water column immediately ventral to the pectoral fin.
